name: scenario_0087
description: Christopher is compiling a report on specific health statistics from various historical and recent documents. He needs to extract specific subsets of data based on given conditions and send the final compilation to his supervisor.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_3]
Query: I need to start compiling some data. Look at this hospital document and find only the services where the Average Days Stay for Private patients is strictly greater than 15.0. Create a new note called 'Filtered Health Stats' and list those matching services.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to look at the provided document and filter the medical services based on the 'Average Days Stay' for Private patients, keeping only those strictly greater than 15.0. Tell it to create a new note called 'Filtered Health Stats' with these matching services. If it includes incorrect services, tell it to double-check the 'Private' sub-column under 'Average Days Stay'. Proceed when the note is created.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_4]
Query: Now check this table of clinical centers. Filter the list to find only the ones where the Relative Risk of CHD is less than 0.500. Append the names of those matching centers to our 'Filtered Health Stats' note.
Instructions: Tell the assistant to examine the provided table and filter the clinical centers, keeping only those where the Relative Risk of CHD is below 0.500. Ask it to append these matching centers to the 'Filtered Health Stats' note. If it includes centers with higher values, point it back to the 'Relative Risk' column. Proceed when the note is updated.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_5]
Query: Next, look at this infographic showing three death phases. Filter them to find any phase where the total number of women who died was 35 or more. Append that matching phase to the note as well.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to review the infographic and identify the death phase where the total number of women who died is 35 or more. Tell it to append the name of this matching phase to the note. If the assistant gets confused by the overall totals or the men's totals, remind it to look specifically at the pink 'WOMEN' total box for each phase. Move on once the note is updated.

ROUND 4 [provide: image_1, image_2]
Query: Check these two new images and filter out any that aren't related to health or medicine. Then, grab the final contents of the 'Filtered Health Stats' note and email it to my supervisor with the subject 'Key Health Stats'.
Instructions: Tell the assistant to check the two new images and ignore them if they are not related to health or medicine. Then, ask it to retrieve the final contents of the 'Filtered Health Stats' note and email it to your supervisor with the subject 'Key Health Stats'. The assistant should notice an ambiguity because you have multiple supervisors (Cesar Maldonado is listed as your manager in your profile, and Dr. Robert Davis is saved as a Supervisor). When it asks for clarification on which person to email, specify that you want to send it to the one at healthresearch.org. End the conversation once the email is sent.

You have 5 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1
  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2
  image_4.jpg -> image ID 3
  image_5.jpg -> image ID 4

## IMAGE DELIVERY

⚠️ IMPORTANT: You MUST use the `send_message_with_image` tool to share images with User B. Do NOT just describe images in text — you MUST call the tool.

Image delivery schedule:

  Round 2: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='3' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
  Round 3: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='4' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
  Round 4: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='0,1' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
